name: week
title: Continuity review
subtitle: Fictional records in demo mode. Read-only review, not emergency dispatch.

sections.title: Recovery readiness
sections.sql: select service,plan,version,status,review_due,exercise_due,latest_exercise,open_actions from readiness order by service

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_items order by due_date nulls first,item

name: dependencies
title: Recovery dependencies
subtitle: Compare recovery evidence with agreed service objectives.

sections.title: Dependency gaps
sections.sql: select service,dependency,rto_hours,recovery_hours,gap_hours,verified_on from dependency_gaps order by gap_hours desc,service

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,item
